strengths.note: Oxidation state is framed as formal ionic bookkeeping, not literal measured charge.
Peroxide exceptions and reaction-dependent n-factor controls use coherent models.

findings.detail: LPAP.C1A.AUTHORITY.BINDING@1 — Claimed Core1A role lacks exact canonical topic/capability binding.
findings.suggested_fix: Bind an approved canonical package or reclassify as extension/resource.

findings.learner_impact: Learners/reviewers cannot distinguish local correctness from exact provenance.
findings.detail: LPAP.C1A.SOURCE.CUSTODY@1 — NCERT/ExamSIDE-style claims are not backed by exact repository custody; the 74-item figure is only an existing benchmark snapshot.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconstruct source custody and re-audit source-linked items.

overall.summary: Local content/runtime quality was improved and the exact browser matrix passes, but authority/source/lineage obligations remain unresolved. This is a coaching recommendation, not an Owner disposition.
